props.name: children
props.description: The content to display in the segmented control.

props.name: isJustified
props.description: Whether the items should divide the container width equally.

props.name: selectedKey
props.description: The id of the currently selected item.

props.name: defaultSelectedKey
props.description: The id of the initially selected item.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the selection changes.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: slot
props.description: Slot name when used in a Spectrum context.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the underlying radiogroup element.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the item, matching the value used in SegmentedControl's selectedKey prop.

props.name: children
props.description: The content to display in the segmented control item.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: ref
props.type: ((el: HTMLButtonElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLButtonElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the underlying button element.

props.name: onClick
props.description: A native click handler, useful for form submission. Note: `onPress` is preferred for cross-device compatibility.

props.name: aria-controls
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the button.

props.name: aria-current
props.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the element that describes the button.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: The id of the element that provides detailed, extended description for the button.

props.name: aria-disabled
props.description: Indicates that the button is perceivable but disabled.

props.name: aria-expanded
props.description: Whether the popup is expanded.

props.name: aria-haspopup
props.description: Whether the button has a popup.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible label for the button.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that labels the button.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the button is disabled.

props.name: elementType
props.description: The HTML element type to use for the button.

props.name: href
props.description: The URL to link to (for anchor elements).

props.name: target
props.description: The target for the link (for anchor elements).

props.name: rel
props.description: The rel attribute for the link (for anchor elements).

props.name: allowFocusWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether to allow focus on the button when it is disabled. This enables showing tooltips on disabled buttons. When true, the button gets `tabIndex=-1` instead of being removed from tab order.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Handler called when the press is released over the target.

props.name: onPressStart
props.description: Handler called when a press interaction starts.

props.name: onPressEnd
props.description: Handler called when a press interaction ends.

props.name: onPressUp
props.description: Handler called when a press is released over the target.

props.name: onPressChange
props.description: Handler called when the press state changes.

props.name: preventFocusOnPress
props.description: Whether the button should not receive focus on press.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether the element should receive focus on render.

props.name: type
props.description: The type attribute for button elements.

props.name: form
props.description: Additional attributes for form buttons.

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute for form buttons.

props.name: value
props.description: The value attribute for form buttons.

props.name: excludeFromTabOrder
props.description: Whether to exclude the button from the tab order.

props.name: toggleKey
props.description: Key used when inside ToggleButtonGroup selection state.
